claims.claim: Argentina's government unveiled a citizenship-by-investment programme offering an Argentine passport for a non-refundable 350,000 US dollar Treasury contribution or an 800,000 US dollar seven-year government bond, with applications to open before the end of the year.
claims.episode_span: One path is a non-refundable contribution of 350,000 US dollars to the Treasury.
claims.source_title: Argentina to sell citizenship to foreigners for US$350,000 to raise dollars
claims.supporting_quote: Argentina's government has unveiled a citizenship-by-investment programme that will allow foreigners to obtain an Argentine passport in exchange for a non-refundable US$350,000 contribution to the Treasury or the purchase of US$800,000 in a seven-year government bond.

claims.claim: Of every 10 reais federal deputies sent in individual amendments over three years, 6 went to cities where they took the largest share of the local vote, and the top 15 percent of those municipalities account for half of 43 billion reais since 2024.
claims.episode_span: Of every ten reais federal deputies sent through individual amendments over the last three years, six went to cities where those deputies took the largest share of the local vote
claims.source_title: Deputados destinam R$ 6 de cada R$ 10 em emendas para municípios onde tiveram melhor desempenho nas urnas
claims.supporting_quote: Um levantamento do GLOBO mostra que de cada R$ 10 enviados pelos deputados via emendas nos últimos três anos, R$ 6 foram para seus "redutos eleitorais", ou seja, para as cidades onde tiveram o voto da maior fatia do eleitorado.

claims.claim: Adolfo Viana sent 4.9 million reais to Pojuca, where he took 19.6 percent of valid votes in 2022, and nothing to Mata de São João, where he took 0.32 percent.
claims.episode_span: Adolfo Viana sent 4.9 million reais to Pojuca, Bahia, where he took 19.6 percent of valid votes for federal deputy in 2022
claims.source_title: Deputados destinam R$ 6 de cada R$ 10 em emendas para municípios onde tiveram melhor desempenho nas urnas
claims.supporting_quote: Enquanto Pojuca foi o destino de R$ 4,9 milhões enviados pelo parlamentar, o município vizinho não recebeu nada de Viana, mesmo tendo índices sócioeconômicos semelhantes.

claims.claim: Elmar Nascimento said he helps the municipalities where he is voted because he does not control the entire federal budget.
claims.episode_span: Elmar Nascimento, a candidate for re-election, told O Globo he helps the places where he is voted
claims.source_title: Deputados destinam R$ 6 de cada R$ 10 em emendas para municípios onde tiveram melhor desempenho nas urnas
claims.supporting_quote: Eu ajudo os que eu sou votado — afirmou Elmar.

claims.claim: Danilo Forte took 14.9 percent in Jaguaribe, which received 10.8 million reais in amendments, and 0.32 percent in Icó, which received none.
claims.episode_span: Jaguaribe, Ceará, where his share was 14.9 percent, received 10.8 million reais, while neighboring Icó, at 0.32 percent, received none.
claims.source_title: Deputados destinam R$ 6 de cada R$ 10 em emendas para municípios onde tiveram melhor desempenho nas urnas
claims.supporting_quote: Jaguaribe recebeu R$ 10,8 milhões em emendas. Icó, nada.

claims.claim: On Saturday in Costa Rica, diesel rose 97 colones a liter to 785, super rose 38 colones to 764, and regular rose 12 colones a liter.
claims.episode_span: Diesel climbed 97 colones a liter, to 785 colones.
claims.source_title: Gas hike in effect today Saturday
claims.supporting_quote: Fuel prices rose on Saturday, led by a sharp ¢97-per-liter increase for diesel. Super gasoline climbed ¢38 per liter, while regular rose ¢12.

claims.claim: Researchers identified Excidobates perplexus in southern Ecuador, a poisonous frog 15.1 to 18.3 millimetres long in two populations, already threatened by mining.
claims.episode_span: Researchers have identified a new poisonous frog in southern Ecuador, Excidobates perplexus, measuring 15.1 to 18.3 millimetres
claims.source_title: Novo sapo venenoso de menos de 2 centímetros é descoberto no Equador e já está ameaçado pela mineração
claims.supporting_quote: Batizado de Excidobates perplexus, o animal tem entre 15,1 e 18,3 milímetros de comprimento e foi identificado em duas populações no sul do país.

claims.claim: Franco Colapinto qualified 15th and will start 21st on Sunday after a 15-place penalty, ahead of Arvid Lindblad, who has a 30-place penalty, while Max Verstappen took pole.
claims.episode_span: Franco Colapinto will start 21st on Sunday because of a pending 15-place grid penalty
claims.source_title: Franco Colapinto largará 21º el Gran Premio de Bahréin en Malasia de Fórmula 1; pole de Max Verstappen
claims.supporting_quote: El piloto argentino concluyó 15º en la prueba de clasificación y, como tenía pendiente una sanción de 15 lugares de rezago en la salida de la carrera de este domingo, quedó, como se preveía, en el fondo de la grilla.

claims.claim: Bolivia enacted a law allowing removal of the attorney general.
claims.episode_span: Bolivia has enacted a law that allows removal of the attorney general, teleSUR English reports.
claims.source_title: Bolivia Enacts Law Allowing Removal of Attorney General
claims.supporting_quote: Bolivia Enacts Law Allowing Removal of Attorney General teleSUR English

claims.claim: The Grenadiers are banned from playing in the Dominican Republic.
claims.episode_span: HaitiLibre reports that the Grenadiers are banned from playing in the Dominican Republic.
claims.source_title: Haiti - FLASH : The Grenadiers Banned from playing in the Dominican Republic
claims.supporting_quote: Haiti - FLASH : The Grenadiers Banned from playing in the Dominican Republic HaitiLibre.com

claims.claim: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court does not set a national alcohol ban on election day; regional courts and security bodies set local rules, and São Paulo, Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro will have none.
claims.episode_span: The Superior Electoral Court sets no national ban.
claims.source_title: Lei Seca vai ser a partir de que horas nas Eleições 2026?
claims.supporting_quote: O Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) não determina uma proibição nacional para bebidas alcoólicas no dia do pleito.

claims.claim: Acre bans alcohol sales including delivery from midnight to 16:00 on 4 October; Amapá from 22:30 on 3 October to 18:00 on 4 October; Alagoas from 03:00 to 18:00; Amazonas from 02:00 to 17:00; Maranhão from midnight to 22:00; Pará and Piauí from midnight to 18:00.
claims.episode_span: Acre’s regional court set that ban from midnight to 16:00 on 4 October
claims.source_title: Lei Seca vai ser a partir de que horas nas Eleições 2026?
claims.supporting_quote: O TRE-AC determinou a proibição de venda, fornecimento, distribuição e consumo, inclusive delivery, da meia-noite às 16h de 4 de outubro.

claims.claim: Abrasel-MG asked the Minas Gerais government not to decree a dry law; São Paulo has had none since 2006 and Rio has not applied one since 1996.
claims.episode_span: The Minas Gerais chapter of the Brazilian Bars and Restaurants Association asked the state government not to decree one.
claims.source_title: Lei Seca vai ser a partir de que horas nas Eleições 2026?
claims.supporting_quote: Em Minas Gerais, a Associação Brasileira de Bares e Restaurantes local (Abrasel-MG) pediu ao governo do estado que não decretasse a Lei Seca nas eleições.

claims.claim: Uruguay ranked third in Latin America and the Caribbean in 2025 for international air passengers per inhabitant, according to Airports Council International figures presented in Lima.
claims.episode_span: Uruguay ranked third in Latin America and the Caribbean in 2025 for international air passengers per inhabitant
claims.source_title: Uruguay ranks third in Latin America for international air passengers per capita
claims.supporting_quote: Uruguay ranked third in Latin America and the Caribbean in 2025 for international air passengers per inhabitant, according to Airports Council International figures presented in Lima this week, despite its small share of the region's total traffic.
